general_threshold_gbp.note: Stated by the live page on the retrieval date: new entrant may be paid 70-90% of the going rate if salary is at least 33,400 GBP/year.

going_rate_gbp.derivation: New entrant floor is 70% of the SOC 2134 standard going rate: 0.7 x 54,700 = 38,290, rounded to the nearest 100 per the published convention. Operator-supplied working figure confirmed against source.

counts_toward_floor.note: Operator-confirmed at the label gate (gate-2 correction 5). Salaries are pro-rated for non-37.5h patterns; labels in this eval use the stated annual base.

not_applicable_lower_going_rate_gbp.note: The going-rates table's 'Lower going rate' column for SOC 2134. Applies only to Health and Care Worker visas and pre-2024-04-04 transitional holders - NOT to new entrants. Documented to preempt confusion; see docs/DATA.md.
